entities.name: B4U8S7 tRNA methylthiotransferase
observations: Exact query sequence match to reviewed UniProt B4U8S7 from Hydrogenobaculum sp. Y04AAS1; 435 aa, predicted mass 49.9 kDa.
Catalyzes conversion of tRNA N6-dimethylallyladenosine (i6A) at position 37 to 2-methylthio-N6-dimethylallyladenosine (ms2i6A), EC 2.8.4.3.
Reference annotation reports two [4Fe-4S] clusters and participation of two S-adenosyl-L-methionine molecules; one cluster has three cysteine ligands and an exchangeable SAM.
Reference annotation reports cytoplasmic localization and monomeric subunit organization.
Predicted domains: UPF0004 at residues 2–101, Radical_SAM at 151–318, and TRAM at 373–431.
Sequence-derived estimates: pI 6.14, GRAVY −0.395, instability index 48.94; estimates do not account for modifications or bound cofactors.
